Using the opposite overall residual convention gives

$$
-\int_\Omega k\nabla T\cdot\nabla v\,d\Omega
+\int_{\Gamma_q}q_{\mathrm{core}}v\,d\Gamma
-\int_{\Gamma_h}h(T-T_\infty)v\,d\Gamma=0.
$$

This is the reference residual multiplied by $-1$. The test function vanishes on $\Gamma_D$,
and the insulated boundary contributes zero.
